back: Current through a metallic conductor is proportional to the p.d. across it, at constant temperature.
Resistor: straight line through origin. Filament lamp: curve flattening (resistance rises). Diode: current in one direction only.

front: Why is a filament lamp non-ohmic?
back: As the current increases it gets hotter and its resistance increases.

front: Effect of length and thickness on a wire's resistance?
back: Longer wire: more resistance (∝ L). Thicker wire: less resistance (∝ 1/A).
Ammeter in series, voltmeter in parallel, vary the current, R = V/I (or the gradient of V against I).
